assumptions.clock: bar k-1 evaluated at minute boundary k (forming bar dropped, as the live scanner does)
assumptions.ltp: open of bar k if it traded, else last traded close (mark only)
assumptions.entry_fill: LTP at k after executor drift/stop checks; requires a traded bar k
assumptions.exit_fill: paper stop and scheduled exits fill at the first traded bar at/after the decision
assumptions.target_exit: none (live book never exits at target; target feeds smart-EOD only)
assumptions.regime: declared constant PR1_CALM; historical regime not reconstructed
assumptions.costs: frozen real equity MIS schedule (brokerage bypass never honoured)
assumptions.kill_switch: replicated inert: runtime settlements never feed PennyRiskEngine.daily_pnl
assumptions.adverse_fill_bound: entry at LTP*1.005 (live entry limit), exits 1% worse (shipped stop/unwind limits)

not_replayed: historical_penny_regime (one declared constant regime per run)
scheduler_jitter (one scan per minute boundary assumed)
re-evaluation_of_an_unchanged_last_bar (each completed bar is evaluated once; gaps are not forward-filled)
intraday_volume_of_forming_bar (cumulative volume uses completed bars only)

daily.point_in_time_rule: bar dated D informs decisions only after D
daily.corporate_action_rule: abs move > 40% reported as suspected, never repaired
